The Office of the Field CCO works with the chief marketing and chief revenue officers of Databricks largest customers to redesign how their commercial organizations operate.
We build a peer community of CMOs and CROs, partner with them on go-to-market transformation programs, and make sure those programs deliver measurable business results.
The work cuts across sales, marketing, field engineering, and partner teams, and it runs on the customer’s own data.
You will be the Field CCO’s right hand and the operator behind the program.

This is a role with broad scope that will require you to collaborate across the business: you will set how we deliver transformation engagements, select and run our first ten pilot accounts, and shape the reusable solutions field engineering builds.
You will get work done through account teams, field engineering, field marketing, and enablement.
This role suits someone who has led client work at a strategy firm and wants to own outcomes, not recommendations.
